fixes: Remove the courier's own body/head from the first-person view (or offset the camera). In armed/frame-007.png (t=77), combat-before/frame-003.png (t=105.5), combat-after/frame-005.png (t=107.6), complete/frame-007.png (t=114.6) and reset/frame-003.png (t=92.0) the pixel under the reticle is the player's own hair/hood, so the still appears to show the crosshair on the player's head even though the trace records first_ray_collider=CounterExfilRunner1 at 107.000–107.400.

Add phase context to the death card during Active: active-death/frame-001.png (t=88.25) shows only COURIER DOWN / HEALTH DEPLETED / PRESS R TO RESTART and silently drops the COUNTER-EXFIL ACTIVE clock and pin counts that failed-death/frame-001.png (t=110.25) correctly carries.
Unify the reset verb across the same incident: 'R reset' (t=77, t=114.6), 'R to retry' (t=110), 'PRESS R TO RESTART' (t=88.25, t=110.25).

Give the escape failure visual corroboration: in escape/frame-004.png (t=110) no runner is on screen at the moment the card asserts 'LEAD RUNNER REACHED THE WEST EXIT'; keep the escaping runner (or an exit flash) in frame, and pull the green west-exit marker fully on-screen (it is half off the right edge in complete/frame-007.png, t=114.6).

Give the armed hint its own line/spacing: in armed/frame-007.png (t=77) 'EXFIL ARMED coupe 20m|E board,F launch' occupies ~90% of the verdict card width with no space around the pipe and comma, reading as part of the completed-relay verdict.
review.summary: All scoped Counter-Exfil items hold in the actual native pixels, cross-checked against the traces. armed/frame-007.png (t=77) keeps the old ending (INTERCEPTION COMPLETE / Stopped 3 / Escaped 0 / Relay complete | R reset) and adds a compact, in-card Armed hint line. combat-before/frame-003.png (t=105.5) shows the live blue coupe, white reticle, three figures in the lane and legible counts (DOWN 0/3 HELD 1 RAN 0, L 6/6 PIN | R2 3/3 | R3 3/3, EXIT 13m, MOUSE0 FIRE). combat-after/frame-005.png (t=107.6) shows exactly the two standard enemies gone (both grey/silver figures absent) with the orange-torso lead still standing at the reticle, and the counts now read DOWN 2/3, R2 DOWN | R3 DOWN, L 3/6 PIN — matching the nine unit-damage camera-aligned events (105.800→107.400, first_ray_collider == target, viewport_contains_center, visual_bounds_ray_hit), distinct lethals Runner3 106.200 / Runner2 106.800, and Runner1 left alive at 3/6 and pinned (12.19s continuous contact at completion 114.433; qualified release 114.933, collision exit 116.680, 63 separated samples, no reentry). complete/frame-007.png (t=114.6) is a coherent foot completion (NO RUNNER REACHED THE WEST EXIT, DOWN 2 / HELD 1, R to reset; HUD still HEALTH 28, matching crossing mode=foot health=28.0), with a downed body at the player's feet and the held runner upright. escape/frame-004.png (t=110) gives a specific, readable escape failure (LEAD RUNNER REACHED THE WEST EXIT, DOWN 0/HELD 0/RAN 1, R to retry). active-death/frame-001.png (t=88.25) shows immediate red COURIER DOWN / HEALTH DEPLETED / PRESS R TO RESTART with HEALTH 0 already in the HUD, and failed-death/frame-001.png (t=110.25) correctly preserves the prior specific failure above the death line. reset/frame-003.png (t=92.0) is living with HEALTH 100 (green) and only fresh COURIER prompt text — no stale DOWN/FAILED/COMPLETE residue; HEALTH 28 is continuous across t=77/105.5/107.6/114.6 and zero only in the declared external-health-zero death cases. Every supplied line lies inside its own card with no clipping or overflow in any frame (widest line, the t=77 armed hint, still fits). The Chicago image is aspiration only and was not scored.
